newsitem.title: USA: St. Jude says Ventritex key. [CORRECTED 16:40 GMT]
newsitem.headline: St. Jude says Ventritex key. [CORRECTED 16:40 GMT]

text.p: St. Jude Medical Inc said Wednesday its proposed acquisition of Ventritex Inc was crucial and without it the company could take years to develop products for the implantable cardiovascular defibrillator market.
St. Jude's proposed $505 million purchase of Ventritex has come under scrutiny (corrects from serenity) after three patients implanted with its heartbeat regulating device died.

"There is no question St. Jude needs to be in this segment of the market and the Ventritex acquisition is our best alternative to do that," Chief Financial Officer Stephen Wilson told a Piper Jaffray Inc analysts meeting in New York.
"If we don't make the acquisition we return to internal development and our time horizon becomes years not months," he said.
By acquiring Ventritex the company said it would have its first approved product for the implantable cardiovascular defibrillator market.
